mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level (as measured by FEDFUNDS) directly increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers a sell-off in equity markets, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.2pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 50th percentile, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 200) signals the central bank's aggressive response, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day returns is negative and statistically insignificant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 0.1% over three months indicates weakening labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate falls below 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth falls below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based economic strength, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 50th percentile, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 thousand units over three months indicates weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0.
